events_format_location_valid.name: events_format_location_valid
events_format_location_valid.value:
(
                ("events"."format" = 'online' and nullif(trim("events"."online_url"), '') is not null)
                or ("events"."format" = 'offline' and nullif(trim("events"."venue_name"), '') is not null)
                or (
                    "events"."format" = 'hybrid'
                    and nullif(trim("events"."online_url"), '') is not null
                    and nullif(trim("events"."venue_name"), '') is not null
                )
            )

events_application_window_order.name: events_application_window_order
events_application_window_order.value: "events"."application_start_at" IS NULL OR "events"."application_deadline" IS NULL OR "events"."application_start_at" <= "events"."application_deadline"
